featureGroupBrief.priceMomentum: moving averages, deviations, returns, and up-day ratios.
featureGroupBrief.marketActivity: trading activity, turnover, liquidity, and price volatility.

featureGroupDescription.priceMomentum: measures price momentum using moving averages, deviations, returns, and up-day ratios to help predict future price movement from the direction, strength, and persistence of recent trends.
featureGroupDescription.marketActivity: measures market activity through trading intensity, turnover, liquidity conditions, and price volatility to identify active trading, thin liquidity, and stagnant capital flows.
